content:
sara_sales: Hey team — Acme POC kickoff tomorrow morning. They need a temporary Dedicated pool and a short burst window. Request: +6 GPUs (A100), allow burst up to 50% for 48h, VPC peering + IP allowlist, and KMS-backed keys for logs. Can we provision and confirm pricing?

mike_se: Got it. Quick clarifying Qs — is the 50% burst on top of the base pool (so base 12 -> burst to 18), or do they expect a fixed extra 6 GPUs only during peaks?

acutal_note: (internal) we usually treat 'burst %' as percent of committed capacity. Example: committed=12 -> 18 at 50%.

nguyen_infra: sara_sales: we can do +6 GPUs ephemeral for 48h. Need the customer CIDR blocks for the allowlist and the VPC peer subnet. Also, which CMK do they want to use? We support customer-managed CMK (alias/aws/redwood-...) or our managed key.

sara_sales: They want to use their CMK (Acme-kms-prod alias: "alias/acme-redwood-poc"). CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.12/32. Also they asked for temporary API keys scoped to the pool and time-limited 72h.

mike_se: For time-limited API keys we can issue scoped creds. Two notes: 1) scoped keys for dedicated pools currently expire max 7d. 2) pricing: short bump (48h) triggers a temporary headroom charge + usage. Rough estimate: 6xA100*48h ~ X compute hours — I'll ping finance for exact.

finance_ops: sara_sales tagging for cost calc. For rough sticker: 6 A100 hours * 48 = 288 GPU-hours. Use dedicated reserved rate for POCs (trial uplift rate). I'll DM exact $ number but expect invoiceable overage unless we apply a promo credit.

eva_security: Two security items: 1) If they bring CMK, we need their key policy to allow Redwood service principal (redwood-kms@redwood.ai) to Encrypt/Decrypt/CreateGrant. 2) For IP allowlist, we need the exact egress IP list from their side for VPC peering verification. Also request a completed minimal PPSL (privacy & security checklist) — small form we send.

sara_sales: I'll get the key policy snippet from Acme and push the PPSL link. Also confirm the 72h scoped API keys vs 48h burst: they want keys valid 72h — fine?

mike_se: That works. Autoscale policy defaults to: min=committed (12), target=committed, burst ceiling=committed*1.5, cooldown=300s. For the POC we can set cooldown=120s to be more responsive. If you want fixed extra nodes instead of percent, say so.

nguyen_infra: Creating the pool now — naming: prod-acme-poc-temp-2024-11-07. Provision steps: create pool, attach CMK alias (requires grant), set autoscaler policy override, create scoped API key with TTL=72h, apply IP allowlist. I'll post the creation runbook here. deploy-bot: pool provisioning queued.

deploy-bot: [system] Pool creation job queued (job_id: job-7f3c9). ETA ~22 minutes. Logs will appear in #eng-releases.

mike_se: One more: route-level rate limits for the POC? Customers often want higher per-route qps during demos. We can temporarily raise per-route qps to 400rps for this pool but that will increase cost. Sara — confirm if they want elevated qps.

sara_sales: Confirmed — Acme asked for 400rps on the demo route for the 6-hour window during the first day. Add that into the config. Also adding a canary fallback to the hosted smaller model if latency > 800ms.

eva_security: Noted on fallback. For logging to their KMS-encrypted bucket, we need their bucket ARN and the PutObject grant. Send it in the PPSL or DM.

nguyen_infra: Update: pool created, attached to VPC peer, CMK grant request sent to Acme. API key ready (scoped) — token: sk_live_poc_XXXX (will DM). Autoscale overridden: min=12, max=18, burst_ceiling=18, cooldown=120s, route_qps_override=/demo:400rps.

mike_se: I'll prepare the short technical note for Acme with the autoscaler behavior and expected tail latency under 400rps. Also adding cost estimate draft for finance.

finance_ops: Drafted cost estimate and promo credit. Sending invoice terms to sara_sales via DM. :money_with_wings:

sara_sales: Thanks team! I'll coordinate the CMK grant and PPSL with Acme and confirm when they've completed the steps. Will post the scoped API key to their secure channel once they finish the SCC form. :thumbsup:
